description: A determinism fixture for the difference and contrast metrics, NOT a claim about physical reality. These functions use more transcendentals than the conversions do — pow, atan2, exp, sin, cos — and ECMAScript specifies all of them as implementation-approximated, so this is where a cross-engine divergence is most likely to appear first.
attested: The Node execution is gated. The browser and React Native executions are attested obligations (ADR-0038), landing with F-017 and F-039/F-040.
